description: Save prompt and Stop message locally; never block development.

hooks.command: node -e "try { const cp = require('node:child_process'); const root = cp.execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], {encoding:'utf8', stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']}).trim(); const result = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, [require('node:path').join(root, 'scripts', 'chat-history.cjs')], {stdio:'inherit'}); if (result.error || result.status !== 0) throw new Error(); } catch { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'ChatHistory: git-root-launch-failed; recording skipped.'}) + '\n'); }"
